artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a horse. The person is facing slightly left, with one hand holding the reins and the other hand resting on the horse. The person has distinct facial features, with hair covered by a large hat adorned with a plume, and is wearing heavy clothing and long boots, with a quiver over their shoulder. The horse is mid-step with raised front legs. In the background, there are other figures on horseback dressed similarly. The sky is lightly clouded, and it appears to be an outdoor setting. The image is enclosed in an oval frame within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man on horseback, with his whole body visible. The man is sitting in a relaxed but upright posture, looking confidently to his left. He has a prominent mustache and beard, with wavy hair partially covered by a hat adorned with a large feather. He is dressed in a richly textured robe-like garment. One of his hands holds the reins of the horse, and the other rests casually. In the background, two other figures on horseback can be seen, both in the middle distance. The scenery behind them shows a vast landscape with cloudy skies, and the ground appears detailed with textured lines indicating movement or pathways. The overall composition suggests motion and grandeur in a moment captured on the plains.

artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a person seated on a large horse, turned slightly away from the viewer with their head tilted to the side. The rider is wearing a loose-fitting cloak and a cap, with curly hair protruding from under the cap. The cloak is draped over their shoulders and ends just above what appears to be a patterned saddle or cloth covering the horse's back. The rider holds onto the horse's reins, which are visible along the animal's neck. In the background, there are two other people on horseback positioned to the left and right of the central figure, as well as two figures standing on foot in the distance. The scene is set within an oval border, which is etched with lines to create a suggestion of clouds in the sky and a landscape that extends into the distance.

artworks.title: The Ruins of the Colosseum
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a scene featuring a ruinous archway and surrounding landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is low, visible through the archway with distant architectural elements against the sky. A few small figures are seen beyond the arches hinting at a larger scene. The style includes intricate and detailed etching lines delineating the textures of stone structures and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and grey against a sepia-toned background. A lone figure is walking amidst what seems to be classical ruins with scattered columns and stones. To the right, there are remnants of a larger structure enveloped by climbing plants.

artworks.title: The Town of Leoni, near Frascati
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins in a monochromatic color palette. The viewer is positioned looking slightly up at the dominating structure. Delicate brushstrokes detail the textured stone architecture. A winding path leads towards the base of the ruins, with small figures and animals present.

artworks.title: Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of an ancient structure from ground level. The ruins dominate the image, with towering walls, arched openings, and jagged textures. There is no distinct horizon line. The ruins and a few trees fill the scene vertically, suggesting they continue into the distance. The painting technique includes stippled and crosshatched brushstrokes for texture. Trees are depicted with a softer stippled technique. The color palette is sepia and black ink on a tan surface. Two small figures add scale to the architecture. Stone debris is scattered around them. In the distance, smaller structures blend into the landscape.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on the ground with a beard, looking up. He is holding a skull in his left hand, resting it on a book. He is surrounded by a cross staff, plants, and there are trees and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting slightly reclined on the left side, with her body turned away but her head turned back towards the right. She has long, wavy hair and classical facial features. She is wearing a draped gown and is surrounded by foliage and draping fabric. To the right, two men are standing behind a lattice fence, leaning towards her and pointing. Next to them, a stone cherub figure with a vase is on the edge of a fountain, with water spouting into the basin below. In the background are trees and a distant structure.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The viewpoint in the image is front-facing, revealing a group of figures interacting closely. The scene depicts detailed foliage and flora, extending into a gathering under a grand tree. Various figures, including a seated female and child engaged with angelic beings, are surrounded by the tree's branches. In the background, there is a serene lake, mountains, and a distant settlement. Clouds float in the sky above. The artwork is created using intricate line work with cross-hatching for depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, utilizing tones of black and white for form and texture.

artworks.title: Small Town (Town Gate at Gorkum?)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of an isolated structure surrounded by trees. The structure is situated on slightly elevated ground, with dense foliage obscuring the low horizon. The artwork has a fine etching style with delicate lines conveying texture and depth. It features a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones, emphasizing a classic feel. In the foreground, there is an arched gate leading to a stream or moat, bordered by vegetation. The composition captures a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Winding Road
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, revealing a view stretching into the distance. The horizon is low, blending with trees, suggesting level ground. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of brown and black ink. Fine lines create texture and depth in trees and ground. A twisted tree is in the foreground, with two small figures on a path in the distance. A cluster of trees in the background merges gently with the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated view of a natural landscape with trees and a winding path. The horizon is low, visible through gaps in the trees, creating depth. The horizon shows sparse details of trees or distant hills. The artwork is executed in fine lines, typical of engraving or etching techniques, creating intricate details of the foliage and path texture. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia brown shades, giving an antique and tranquil look. The path curves through trees in the foreground, leading to a less dense area in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bending Tree
artworks.description: The view is from a slightly elevated position, looking across a landscape with a body of water. The horizon is relatively high in the image, drawing the eye to a cluster of trees. The brushstrokes, or etching lines, are intricately detailed, with a precise hand evident in the depiction of tree foliage and reflections on the water. The color palette consists of soft sepia tones. Closest to us, a gentle slope leads down to the water, and trees frame the scene. The background reveals more trees and a sky, enhancing the depth of the composition.

artworks.title: Landscape with Four Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with dense trees on the right side and a body of water stretching across the frame. The etching employs fine lines and cross-hatching to create depth and texture. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of sepia and black. Close to the viewer, a dirt path runs alongside the water, with two small figures walking on it. The land gently slopes towards the water with reflections on its surface.

artworks.title: Landscape with River and Rock
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water reflecting surrounding scenery. A line of trees obscures the horizon, dividing the earth and sky. The scene is highly detailed, with brushstrokes giving texture to the foliage and rocky hillside. The color palette is dominated by shades of brown, creating a warm, monochromatic look. Two figures and a dog walk along a path near the water. Lush trees in the background add to the peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Der Polster (The Cushion)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with her arms raised and hands covering her head. She has dark, shoulder-length hair and wears a long dress. The background includes a green patterned cushion and other shadows of yellow and brown. The setting appears to be indoors with a partial view of a window or wall decoration at the top. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Beheading of John the Baptist
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This image features a man holding a sword in a dark, stone-walled room. The room has an irregularly shaped opening emitting sparse lighting in the background. A chain hangs from the left wall near a wooden trapdoor. In the foreground, the man raises his arms with the sword, casting deep shadows. His focus is on an object on the ground, while figures peer into the room through the hole in the background. A decapitated head is near the man's feet. The scene conveys suspense and intensity through strong lines and shading, emphasizing the dark atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Column: pl.1
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with cliffs, mountains, trees, a tall structure resembling a column, a watermill, and rocky terrain in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is sepia and black.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape: pl.2
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape viewed from a rocky valley, emphasizing towering cliffs against the sky. The style resembles etching with detailed linear strokes depicting rocks and vegetation. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of black and white. Figures appear near us: one seated, two walking with a dog. In the background, a rugged landscape unfolds with scattered trees on rocky surfaces, leading to distant cliffs and peaks.

artworks.title: Riverscape with Rocks on the Right: pl.3
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, facing a vast and dramatic scene. The horizon is high, with a rocky mountain range dominating the right side. On the left, tall trees with detailed branches and leaves stand. These trees lead the eye towards calm waters beyond. More trees in the distance connect the water to the mountainous backdrop. The etched lines vary in thickness, providing texture and dimension. The sky above shows subtle swirling patterns indicating clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and black tones.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape with Fir: pl.4
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky formation dominating the left side. The horizon is suggested in the upper third, where the sky meets the distant terrain. The brushwork is intricate, with fine lines used to depict rocks, trees, and figures, giving the image a detailed appearance typical of etching. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and beige achieved through shading and crosshatching, creating an antique and textured feel. Closest to us, a rocky outcrop holds a tall, slender tree extending towards the right. In the middle distance, smaller trees and vegetation rise gently into the landscape. In the distance, the land fades into the sky, which is more sparsely detailed, emphasizing the sky's openness.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape with Cross: pl.5
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with mountains stretching across the horizon. A cross stands on a rise. The style is characterized by intricate lines and textures typical of etching. The scene is in black and white. Two trees frame the view on the left, their branches extending into the composition. The detailed foliage conveys movement and depth.

artworks.title: The Waterfall: pl.6
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, ground, rocks, and a sky with clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with a Cart: pl.8
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a road winding through it. On the road, a horse with a rider and a cart are visible. Mountains or cliffs can be seen in the distance blending into the sky. The scene is framed by trees on both sides, some with leaves and one barren. The artwork features intricate etching lines to define shapes and shadows, giving the composition depth. The image is rendered in grayscale with sepia tones, creating a classic and timeless visual impact.
